usage: The phrase '做功課' functions as a verb phrase, meaning 'to do homework'.
It is commonly used in everyday conversation to talk about completing school assignments.
You can use '做功課' with subjects or objects to specify who is doing the homework and what homework it is.
This phrase appears mainly in informal and semi-formal contexts when discussing study routines.

examples.meaning: I have to do homework tonight.
